<<Disposing of Military Insignia Collection>>

If you're looking to get rid of your military insignia collection, one option is to consider donating it to a charity that supports veterans or their families. Many organizations, such as the Disabled American Veterans (DAV) or the Wounded Warrior Project, accept donations of military memorabilia, including insignia. This way, your collection can be put to good use and may even bring some comfort to those who have served.

******


Another option is to consider consigning your collection to a reputable dealer or auction house that specializes in military items. They can help you determine the value of your collection and find a buyer who is interested in purchasing it. Alternatively, you could consider selling your collection online through a platform like eBay or Etsy. However, be aware that selling online may require some effort to take high-quality photos and write detailed descriptions of each item. If you're not comfortable with the process, you could consider hiring a professional to help you with the sale.
